recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Only revisit the List.status code set if FHIR-55173 or another future final work-group decision approves an unknown/other escape valve or changes the status cardinality/binding.
issue_request: FHIR-5839 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core List. It asked for a List lifecycle status to support XDS Folder use cases, with the approved resolution to add current, retired, and entered-in-error.
initial_application: Historical commit db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 listed {#5839} among PC-approved change requests and added List.status as a 1..1 code bound to ListStatus with short text current | retired | entered-in-error, plus current status values in List examples.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active [resources] entry list=List, placing the current List resource source in build scope. FHIR-3643 is a related Resolved - No Change issue explicitly covered by FHIR-5839. Later FHIR-55173 and FHIR-55174 ask about escape-valve codes for List.status and List.mode, but both remain Triaged/Unresolved; the related Zulip discussion did not record a final decision superseding FHIR-5839.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml defines List.status as a mandatory code with a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/list-status, and source/list/codesystem-list-status.xml contains current, retired, and entered-in-error.

related_jiras.note: Earlier List status request was resolved No Change because it was covered by FHIR-5839.
Later Triaged/Unresolved request asks for a List.status escape valve; it is not a final source-edit decision.
Companion Triaged/Unresolved List.mode escape-valve request appeared in the same later discussion but is outside the seed status-code change.
